programmes.d: When Ray accidentally destroys Henry's dad's prized remote control car, they throw a manicure/pedicure party to raise money to fix it.
As Henry tries to adjust to his new role as Kid Danger, he struggles to balance his schedule between crime-fighting, school and family.
After Henry's mother's purse is stolen, Captain Man decides he must move in with Henry's family in order to protect them.
Luna learns Chunk was like her in high school and worries her ambition to be a rocker is unrealistic; Lincoln wages war after his food is filched from the refrigerator.
Lincoln is unable to sleep after watching a scary movie, so he stays awake all night; when a common cold spreads through the Loud house, Lincoln believes his sisters have turned into zombies.
Lincoln's sisters accidentally get him four dates for the Sadie Hawkins dance at school; when Lincoln and Bobby become friends, Lori sets out to make Bobby jealous by spending time with Clyde.

After discovering he has rituals, Lincoln worries he's predictable and vows to change things up; Lori develops the yips when she finds out that the golf coach from her dream college is coming to see her play.

When Carl witnesses Ronnie Anne save a dog, he becomes obsessed with being just like his newfound hero; Ronnie Anne secretly starts watching her family's favorite telenovela after refusing to watch it with them.

All of Lincoln's sisters develop a crush on his new tutor, making it impossible for Lincoln to study; the children complain about their house, but they start to feel differently after a tornado threatens to destroy it.

Afraid they will be forgotten, Lincoln and Clyde want to make a splash in the yearbook and crash group photos; seeing his sisters fight with their roommates, Lincoln suggests a room shuffle based on a compatibility test.

When Lincoln and Clyde both get an internship at Flip's, they compete to win the title of manager; after seeing how tame Pop Pop has gotten in his advanced age, Lincoln takes him out for a day to remember.
When Carol Pingrey's photograph gets more "likes" on social media than Lori's, she tries to one-up her; thinking it looks like fun, the other kids try to get in on Lola's home-schooling.

Lincoln wishes he had 10 brothers instead of 10 sisters, and Lisa gives him a glimpse into that reality; Lola wants to be a part of the siblings' secrets club, but her siblings are reluctant to let in a tattle tale.
Lisa searches for the next big scientific breakthrough; Luna decides whether to play in a band with her friends or play with professionals.

After a pun-filled trip to the grocery store with Luan and Lola, Dad worries Lola thinks he plays favorites; when Lynn's friend Margo is celebrated for a one-in-a-million soccer goal, Lynn tries to be supportive.
SpongeBob orders fake arms; Squidward pretends to be a ghost.
Mr. Krabs promises a clown will perform at his playground of junk; SpongeBob and Patrick go camping in the backyard.

Paper makes Scissors feel bad for not doing his New Year's resolution, so Scissors tries to do it in 12 hours; in order to feel smart, Paper puts together a book club with the least intelligent people he knows.

The trio goes on an unnecessarily action-packed adventure with Paper's sister, Sandpaper, to get seven key limes; when Rock's TV dinner isn't as plentiful as advertised, he fights for justice; Scissors works for the company.
Timmy goes back in time to try to change Mr. Crocker's past so that he will be a happier person in the present.
Timmy tries to help Catman find a safer job; Timmy's mother turns their house into a bed and breakfast.
Timmy tampers with history after he breaks his dad's grade school trophy; Timmy and Wanda try to rescue Cosmo.
When Cosmo and Wanda bring Timmy back through time to meet their former Godchildren, his interactions with them alter the future.
Wanda visits her successful twin sister, Blonda; Timmy helps Mark Chang celebrate the Yugopotamian holiday FLARG.
Timmy's parents discover that he has fairy godparents.
Timmy wishes for master kung-fu skills in order to fight a bully; Timmy travels back in time and encounters a crazed witch-hunter.
Timmy tries to thwart his parents' plans for his birthday party; Timmy discovers that his mother wants to spend time with him.
Timmy tries to scare away houseguests; an unappreciated Timmy wishes that he were never born.
Timmy frees the caged, prize goat Chompy, which Vicky gets blamed for; Timmy wishes everyone could be exactly the same.
The gang searches through Cosmo's memories of his teenage years to discover why he never graduated from the Fairy Academy.
Timmy wishes that the entire world would be quiet; Chester and A.J. are suspicious of Timmy's sudden popularity.
Timmy adopts a mischievous fairy dog.
Everyone that Timmy cares about vanishes; Cosmo must receive a gland transplant.
Poof must stop his anti-fairy from destroying the Fairy World and his loved ones.
Vicky kidnaps a teen singing sensation; Timmy challenges Vicky for the title of Queen of the Skatepark.
Vicky advertises on the radio; Mark Chang seeks Timmy's help in defeating an alien race.

Timmy wishes Mr. Dinkleberg would replace Dad as Squirrelly Scout leader; amnesiac Cosmo believes he is Dad's genie.
When Poof has trouble falling asleep, Wanda tries to help by reading him a book of classic fairy tales.
Problems occur when Timmy leaves his Crimson Chin comic on the side of his bathtub; Timmy wishes for the height and skills of a basketball superstar.
Mr. Crocker receives the magic lava lamp as a present; Jorgen plans to use Timmy's tooth as an engagement ring for the Tooth Fairy.
When Timmy's father is too busy to spend time with him, he wishes for more fathers; the Squirrelly Scouts and the Cream Puffs race to the top of Mount Doom.
Timmy wishes himself doll-sized for an adventure with his action figure; Timmy's parents suspect he is shoplifting.
Cosmo is chosen to be the host of the secret fairy convention; Timmy sends Wanda to a spa for a day off.
Crocker seeks out a new source of magic from Timmy's house; Timmy wishes that he were smarter than everyone else.
After a freak jousting accident, SpongeBob and Patrick are transported to a medieval version of Bikini Bottom.
Squidward swallows his clarinet reed; Patrick disguises himself as a girl.
SpongeBob and Patrick take Squidward jellyfishing; SpongeBob is a victim of Plankton's scheme.
Not knowing the contents of Pat's secret box drives SpongeBob crazy; Squidward lies to an old rival about having a band.
SpongeBob's breath smells after he eats sea onion ice cream; Mr. Krabs gives his daughter Pearl a job at Krusty Krab.
Stardom goes to SpongeBob's head after he appears in Krabs' low-budget commercial; Squidward becomes impoverished.
SpongeBob takes Mr. Krabs' daughter to the prom; SpongeBob and Squidward compete to be employee of the month.
The enemies of the Star family team up to exact revenge; Bunny loses a tattoo.
Cecil teaches Patrick how to drive; Patrick time-travels in a race for the Krusty Krab's newest menu item.
After activating an atomic bomb in the Man Cave, Ray and Henry decide to drive it out into the Swellview desert in order to save their city.
Henry is not invited to a birthday party because he is accused of throwing the birthday girl from a roof; Captain Man agrees to help Henry clear his name.
When the Vice Mayor cuts Captain Man and Kid Danger's budget to build a high-speed railway in Swellview, the duo must figure out creative ways to save money.
